rules.title: Complete portal category source bound
rules.description: Every production plan must bind the complete 1124-category portal source.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Canonical complete editorial plan bound
rules.description: Every candidate must resolve to one of 5660 unique canonical plan slots.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Full WordPress inventory before generation
rules.description: Published, draft and trash posts must be read-only inventoried before reservation.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Technical artifacts canonicalized
rules.description: Technical test artifacts must not count as production coverage but remain in duplicate diagnostics.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Systemwide duplicate guard
rules.description: Duplicates and keyword ownership collisions across portal, journal and all WordPress statuses must block.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Journal separate content block
rules.description: Journal is a footer-only content block and page 9886 must never become a taxonomy parent.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Nine Journal categories
rules.description: All nine Journal categories must resolve read-only and exactly by name, slug and category taxonomy at runtime; the new category term ID is never hardcoded.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Legacy Wissen remains draft-blocked
rules.description: Legacy internal Wissen remains planning/dedup identity only and cannot generate drafts or publish; the external signed Journal type owns new Journal drafts.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Runtime plan state separate from master
rules.description: The master is archival; runtime plan state is reconciled from WordPress and protected post/option state.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Versioned category reimport
rules.description: Added, renamed, moved or deactivated categories require versioned snapshot and conflict review.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: No silent stable identity change
rules.description: Term IDs are runtime-only and rename/move/deactivation cannot silently change stable identity.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Initial wave maximum four
rules.description: The first regular production wave creates at most four drafts and at most one per released article type.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Automatic publish forbidden
rules.description: No editorial plan slot, runtime state or production path may permit automatic publication.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Trash duplicate protection
rules.description: Nontechnical trash content blocks silent recreation until explicitly resolved.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Read-only Journal snapshot
rules.description: Journal hub and categories are checked without WordPress writes before production.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest

rules.title: Readback updates canonical runtime state
rules.description: Every successful draft readback updates its canonical plan state and retains publish false.
rules.required_evidence: raw stdout, stderr, exit code, contracts and signed build manifest
